summary: This directory orchestrates automated code analysis, documentation generation, and maintenance pipelines. It provides a modular framework for managing source code metadata, resolving prompt templates, and executing transformation tasks to keep documentation and code structures synchronized.
responsibilities: Orchestrate documentation and code analysis pipelines
Define structural metadata and schemas for source code
Resolve and load prompt templates for automated tasks
Execute and validate documentation and code transformations
Provide infrastructure for verifying pipeline outputs
relationships: Pipeline execution engines utilize structural metadata and schemas to interpret the context of source code files.
Prompt templates provide the specific instructional logic required for automated generation and translation tasks.
Verification components ensure that the outputs produced by pipelines adhere to defined structural requirements and quality standards.
Strategy patterns allow the system to resolve the appropriate execution logic based on the complexity of the task.
designDecisions: Separation of concerns between data definitions, prompt management, and execution logic.
Use of interface-based contracts to maintain consistent data modeling across different pipelines.
Registry and strategy patterns to facilitate modular extension of generation logic.
Decoupling of template loading mechanisms from the core execution engine.
Collocation of test infrastructure with pipeline logic to ensure consistent verification.
